extracted.intended_audience: readers, instructors, and typesetters of Lawrence C. Evans' Partial Differential Equations (2nd ed.); textbook users and errata contributors
extracted.subtask_description: A compiled errata list enumerating typographical, notational, and mathematical corrections for the second edition of a PDE textbook. Intended to guide corrections to printed math expressions, cross-references, variable names, and problem statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accurate domain and interval notation
rubrics_metrics.description: Mathematical statements must use correct domain/interval notation for variables and sets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples corrected: change to “(x, t) ∈ Rn × (0, ∞)”; change “R+ = (0, ∞)”; ensure ; after (0, ∞) where required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consistent and correct variable naming
rubrics_metrics.description: Variables and symbols must be used consistently and correctly throughout (no inadvertent renaming or mis-typed symbols).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: change q to v(p, x) or to v; change b to β; change x0 to 0; change u to uλ; change q to v; change ‘ur ∈ Sk(ul)’ spelling/formatting corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct equation labels and cross-references
rubrics_metrics.description: References to numbered equations, problems, sections, and appendices must point to the correct labels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: change references to “C.5”, “5.8.3”, “5.8.5”, “(32)”, “§C.8”; delete or correct wrong cross-reference markers like “(53)”.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eliminate extraneous characters and typographical junk
rubrics_metrics.description: Remove stray letters, symbols, or duplicated characters that have no meaning in context.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: delete extraneous “C”; delete extra “= 0”; delete second “C k,β( ¯U )”; remove stray quotation marks or duplicated characters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include missing differential elements and integral components
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrals and differential expressions must include the correct differential (e.g., dt) and all necessary terms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: add “dt” to the second integral; in integral (27) add the term (n−3)u^2; add missing term |x|^2+t^2 in an expression.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct algebraic expressions, exponents, and signs
rubrics_metrics.description: Algebraic terms, exponents, fractions, and signs must be mathematically correct and typeset properly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: remove extra “-” in an exponent; correct expressions like u(x/|x|^2)|x|^{2−n}; (n−3)(n−1)u^2 / 4|x|^2; add missing factors or terms as indicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Precise summation/index ranges
rubrics_metrics.description: Summation indices and ranges must be stated correctly (which indices run over which ranges).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: change sum to be for i, j, k, l = 1 to n.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accurate statement of assumptions needed for estimates
rubrics_metrics.description: Problems and propositions must include all assumptions required to derive stated estimates or conclusions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: in Problem 7 require also c(u) ∈ L^2 and rephrase to derive ||D^2 u||_{L^2} ≤ C ||f||_{L^2}; Problem 6(b) rewrite to assume u is the solution and derive representation formula.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct boundary and initial condition expressions
rubrics_metrics.description: Boundary/initial conditions must be written correctly and refer to the correct functions and sets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: change ψ = 0 on ∂E(r) − (0, 0); change u = 0 to v = 0; specify w, w' → 0 fast enough as r → ∞.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct operator and function argument notation
rubrics_metrics.description: Operators, function names, and their arguments must be written unambiguously and consistently.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: change to F(D^2 v(x0), Dv(x0), x0); correct H conditions involving gradients along Γ and λ in convex combinations; ensure D_p L is used where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct matrix and tensor entries/typesetting
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries in matrices or block matrices must be the correct symbols and positioned correctly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: lower left entry in B_0 should be a_{n1}; B[v(0), v(0); 0] corrected; ensure B(x,t;y) notation is correct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct problem statements and constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: Problem formulations must include any constraints or normalizing conditions required by the exercise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: Problem 17 — add “subject to the constraint that ∫_U w^2 / |x|^2 dx = 1” (as indicated); rewrite problems to include omitted hypotheses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fix typographic placement of special characters and accents
rubrics_metrics.description: Diacritics, tildes, and other special typographic marks should be placed correctly on symbols.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: should be “˜u(s, ω) =” in (30); ensure displayed tildes and hats appear over correct letters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct punctuation around mathematical statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Punctuation (commas, semicolons, periods) around equations and mathematical clauses must be correct for readability and correctness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: add missing semicolon after (0, ∞); change wording/commas as in multiple line corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct formatting of norms and inequalities
rubrics_metrics.description: Norms and inequality chains must be typeset and ordered correctly to reflect the intended mathematical meaning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: change to “−||I[...] [η_t(u)]|| ≤ −σ ≤ −σ^2” as corrected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accurate citation and reference names
rubrics_metrics.description: Bibliographic names and references must be spelled correctly and any added references must be placed properly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: change to “Bressan”; add line “Section 11.2 See P. Lax (Comm Pure and Applied Math 10 (1957), 537–566).”

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct function/codomain declarations
rubrics_metrics.description: When a function appears, its domain and codomain should be explicitly stated where relevant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: should be w : R^n × R → R (correct codomain specification).

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct Jacobian/representation formula statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Representation formulas involving characteristics and Jacobians must be stated exactly and include correct arguments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: Problem 6(b) should read u(x,t) = g(x(0, x, t)) J(0, x, t).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure operators/actions are applied to correct variables
rubrics_metrics.description: When differential or other operators are used, ensure they apply to the correct function and variable (avoid mismatched subscripts/superscripts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: change to Fx_j F_{p_j} (notation for partial derivatives) and similar corrections to ensure derivatives are displayed correctly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct multi-line and displayed-equation line breaks
rubrics_metrics.description: Line breaks and alignment in multi-line displays should not change the meaning and must be consistent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: several multi-line displays are corrected for missing or moved characters (e.g., line edits on pages 366–367 and others).

rubrics_metrics.name: Restore or correct omitted equation terms in displayed formulas
rubrics_metrics.description: If a term was omitted in a displayed equation, add it so the formula matches the mathematical derivation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: add missing |x|^2+t^2 term; add (n−3)u^2 in an integral; replace or add terms shown in errata list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct label or symbol for eigenvalues/constants
rubrics_metrics.description: Named constants or spectral quantities must be labeled correctly to avoid confusion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: change to λ_1 where appropriate.
